verse.verse_1: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse.verse_2: Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds;
verse.verse_4: Master of the Day of Judgment.
verse.verse_5: Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek.
verse.verse_7: The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray.
